IndexPage.about: I’ve been working as a Web Developer since 2021 and I’m currently a Front-End Developer at Petlove.

Highlights.title: Highlights
Highlights.description: The results I'm proudest of, measured in production.

ux.label: manual extraction in 2.5 months
ux.detail: −64% clicks right after shipping · 93% of interactions now on the new flow

accessibility.label: on Lighthouse, up from ~64
accessibility.detail: Audit and fixes across more than 10 pages: labels, ARIA, landmarks, and semantics

devsecops.label: weekly dependency security, built with AI (Cursor)
devsecops.detail: Cleared every critical audit finding in its first cycle, with a single PR and Slack alerts

security.label: and unsafe redirect fixed
security.detail: Reduced critical vulnerabilities, with security standards documented for the team

designSystem.label: open-source design system
designSystem.detail: Components, issues, and code review, reducing the development time of new features

openSource.title: Contributions to projects many people rely on

items.clarity: Identified, via Microsoft Clarity heatmaps, a pattern of repeated clicks on a high-usage field: 1,928 clicks in 6 days, signaling friction in how users extracted the information. Shipped a dedicated solution for the case, with an immediate 64% drop in clicks. Two and a half months later, the new path accounts for 93% of interactions and manual extraction fell by 91%.

items.audit: Led an accessibility audit and fixes on the health center portal, raising the average Lighthouse accessibility score from ~64 to ~97 across more than 10 pages, fixing label associations, ARIA structure, landmarks, and semantic attributes in Vue components.

items.dependencies: Built, with AI support (Cursor), a weekly dependency security automation (front and back end), with a single PR for compatible patches and a Slack alert only for critical findings or an all-clear, cutting down the manual tracking of updates. In its first cycle it cleared every critical audit finding and standardized the team's review ritual.

items.honeybadger: Handled triage and fixes for bugs monitored via Honeybadger, analyzing production exceptions, estimating each bug and alert with AI support (Claude), and organizing the fix queue by criticality and effort.

items.confluence: Documented business rules and feature flows in Confluence, centralizing behavior criteria and technical specs as a reference for the team.

items.mvp: Led the frontend development of a cloud backup SaaS MVP for MSPs and companies in regulated industries.
items.architecture: Defined frontend architecture decisions, documenting technical choices and establishing standards.

items.uiux: Designed and implemented the UI/UX, creating layouts, user flows, and a scalable design system (colors, typography, spacing, and component patterns) in Figma.

items.stakeholders: Collaborated with stakeholders to define and refine business rules and product flows.
items.consistency: Ensured consistency between product requirements, UX decisions, and technical implementation.

items.cloudApis: Integrated the frontend with cloud APIs, including user management, authentication flows, and core CRUD operations.

items.pipeline: Optimized the CI/CD pipeline by parallelizing test execution and code analysis (Sonar), reducing build/deploy time from ~1h to ~12 minutes (~80% reduction) and eliminating bottlenecks in the delivery process.

items.redirect: Resolved a security issue in the application's redirection, preventing user cookies/cache from being compromised through external links.
items.xss: Resolved an XSS issue in a web component, preventing HTML Injection through the component's fields.

items.atomium: Worked on component development in the Atomium Design System (open-source), reducing the development time of new features. Prioritized demands, developed components, resolved issues, and reviewed PRs.

items.nuxt: Contributed to Nuxt.js by reporting and documenting an issue, helping identify a build problem in version 3.16.0+ and discussing the solution.
items.unleash: Contributed to Unleash (JS SDK) with a Pull Request, improving the library and collaborating with the project's core. The change was made to benefit how we use Unleash in our applications.

items.adrs: Redesigned the front-end engineering team's documentation process, centralizing ADRs and assorted documentation. Created and documented front-end security solutions, reducing critical vulnerabilities by 100% and establishing standards for the team.

items.marketplace: Developed critical features for the marketplace platform and website (juntosomosmais.com.br), increasing conversion and customer satisfaction.

items.feasibility: Developed technical POCs to evaluate the feasibility of new features (including animations), guiding architectural decisions and reducing technical debt.

items.refactoring: Reduced technical debt through refactoring, optimizations, and performance improvements.
items.chunkErrors: Contributed to reducing technical debt through refactoring, optimizations, security fixes, and performance improvements, such as handling chunk errors.

items.alignment: Collaborated with product, UI/UX, and engineering to align technical solutions with business objectives.
items.squadFlow: Contributed to improving the squad's workflow both individually and collectively.
items.events: Participated in meetings and events focused on front-end and other broad topics, connecting with professionals who have enhanced my technical and interpersonal development.

items.articles: Created articles on React Design Patterns concepts such as Compound Components, Error Boundaries, etc.

items.architecture: Improved the project through architecture management and organization.
items.reviews: Reviewed and merged pull requests, provided suggestions, and answered questions.

items.website: Front-end development contributions to a website project that was paused.
items.improvements: Participation and contributions to project improvements.

items.meetings: Attended meetings to improve communication and help steer project development with the team.
items.learning: Opportunity to work with a dedicated and welcoming team, where I had space to learn new technologies from scratch.

items.technologies: Main technologies used: JavaScript ES6+, Next.js, React.js, Chakra UI, Git, and GitHub.

items.issue: Contributed to Nuxt.js by reporting and documenting an issue, helping identify a build problem in version 3.16.0+ and discussing the solution.

items.pullRequest: Contributed to Unleash (JS SDK) with a Pull Request, improving the library and collaborating with the project's core to benefit how the application uses it.

items.contributions: Active contributions to the Atomium and Venice Design Systems (components, documentation, and code review).

items.content: Author of technical articles (Blog, DEV.TO, TabNews), active member and collaborator in He4rt Developers community projects, attending community talks, and answering technical questions on Stack Overflow (EN and PT-BR).
